lcc_original: 因爲再過七天，我要下雨在地上，四十晝又四十夜，將我所造的衆生都從地上擦滅。』
notes: LCC 下雨 corresponds to UNV 降雨 (WH04305 = מָטָר, rain); same verb, different compound in Chinese.

UNV has implicit {<WH0705>} for the second '四十' (forty) before 夜, because UNV writes '四十晝夜' without repeating 四十. LCC explicitly writes '四十晝又四十夜', so Rule 3 applies: drop braces and attach <WH0705> to the explicit 四十 before 夜.
LCC 衆生 ('all living beings') covers both UNV 各種<WH03605> (כֹּל = all) and 活物<WH03351> (יְקוּם = living substance); both SNs co-attached to 衆生.
LCC 將 corresponds to UNV 把 — both serve as object-marker particles translating אֵת (WAH0853).
LCC 擦滅 corresponds to UNV 除滅 (WH04229 = מָחָה, to wipe/blot out); WTH8804 (Qal perfect) attaches to 擦滅 as in UNV.
